_doc: THE ONION ROSTER: every onion-layer source the onion forest has assessed, refused ones included. Reviewed input, never written by an organ (box-side address and terms reads go to data/onion_roster_state.json). A row is FETCHED only when its address is VERIFIED from the publisher's OWN clearnet page and its terms_verdict is ALLOWED; a mirror inherits its publisher's clearnet terms and robots (governance/tor-proxy-ruling-2026-11-17.md). Kinds allowed: news_mirror, institution_mirror, public_forum (after per-source review), dataset, index. Markets, leak/ransomware sites, carding sites, dump sites and any recursive crawler are excluded by RULE and never appear as rows (libs/data/onion_fetch + research/onion_forest.FORBIDDEN_KINDS). Text claims only.
assessed_from: cloud container: the egress proxy refused every publisher host (bbc.co.uk, propublica.org, nytimes.com, dw.com, voanews.com, rferl.org, theguardian.com, zenodo.org, torproject.org answered CONNECT 403), so no publisher page and no terms page could be read through the robots gate. Every candidate address below is therefore UNVERIFIED_ADDRESS and every terms verdict TERMS_UNREAD until the box reads them (onion_forest.verify_roster runs every pass on the box, clearnet only, robots-gated). Addresses are listed as CANDIDATES to check verbatim on the named publisher page; none is ever fetched until that check passes.

excluded_by_rule.why: never: owner's N7 rule and the tor-proxy ruling line 4
never: owner's N7 rule; the 20:33Z widening to public forums excludes any market, leak or carding venue
never by SOURCE KIND; a claim that merely says 'leaked' elsewhere is a rumour claim, not an exclusion (20:34-20:35Z)
never: possession of card data is itself unlawful
never: allowlist of reviewed feeds and pages only

sources.terms_why: terms page unreachable from the cloud container; read on the box. Reading hint, NOT a verdict: the BBC terms are expected to limit use to personal, non-commercial use, in which case this row becomes BLOCKED_ON_TERMS.
sources.mechanism_note: business and world news: policy, commodity and FX event claims for MT5 macro instruments

terms page unreachable from the cloud container. Reading hint, NOT a verdict: ProPublica's republishing licence is non-commercial; whether reading for claims (no republication) is allowed needs the terms text.

sources.mechanism_note: multilingual world service: sanctions, energy and EM politics

sources.terms_why: no onion address known from an RFE/RL page; terms unread.

sources.terms_why: REFUSED: the Guardian's onion service is SecureDrop, a source-submission system for whistleblowers, not a text mirror. It is never read; there is no Guardian text page on the onion layer to assess.
NO_MECHANISM: the Tor Project's own site carries software and network news, which names no testable mechanism for an MT5 instrument. Refused on relevance, not on terms.

NO_MECHANISM (11-11 verdict re-confirmed, not re-read: zenodo.org refused CONNECT from the container): the academic onion-graph datasets are hyperlink and service-uptime telemetry of onion sites. They carry no text claim and name no market mechanism; their CC licences (per record) are moot. It is clearnet and would never travel over Tor in any case.
sources.mechanism_note: none: network structure, not market claims

sources.terms_why: REFUSED on terms (11-11 verdict stands, tor-proxy ruling line 5): Ahmia's terms and the MNPI gate. A search index would also be the route into a crawl, which this lane does not do.
sources.mechanism_note: none: an index, not a source
